meta.driver: Hibernate ORM 6.4.4.Final + HikariCP 5.1.0 via P6Spy proxy

notes.query_counting: Query count tracked via P6Spy JDBC proxy (P6SpyQueryListener). P6Spy intercepts all statements sent to PostgreSQL driver.
notes.join_fetch: JOIN FETCH works correctly in Hibernate 6.4.4 JPQL — unlike Doctrine 3.x which has a DQL parser bug. A4, B1, B3 all use JOIN FETCH and produce single queries.
notes.A3: query_count_median: 100 — Hibernate lazy-loads user per order via proxy object, confirming N+1 behaviour.
notes.A4: query_count_median: 1 — JOIN FETCH resolves N+1 in a single query.
notes.B1: query_count_median: 1 — LEFT JOIN FETCH across 3 levels (Order → Items → Product → Category) in single query. n_warmup: 2000 due to random orderId causing high CV.
notes.B3: query_count_median: 1 — JOIN FETCH on category resolves in single query.
notes.C1: query_count_median: 2 — P6Spy counts JDBC batch execution: 1 for INSERT batch + 1 for DELETE cleanup. Hibernate uses session.doWork() for raw JDBC batch access.
notes.C2: query_count_median: 2 — native SQL UPDATE FROM subquery (LIMIT 1000) + restore. JPQL does not support LIMIT on UPDATE. See methodology/c2_limit_analysis.json.
notes.D1: query_count_median: 11 — 1 SELECT user + 1 SELECT products + 1 INSERT order (flush) + 5 INSERT items (flush) + 1 UPDATE total (flush) + 2 DELETE cleanup.

A1.description: Simple SELECT by primary key via EntityManager.find()

A2.description: Filtered list with ORDER BY and LIMIT via JPQL

A3.description: N+1 diagnostic — 100 orders, lazy-loads user per order via Hibernate proxy (intentional)

A4.description: Eager loading via JOIN FETCH — orders with users in single query

B1.description: Deep eager load via LEFT JOIN FETCH — Order → Items → Product → Category in single query

B2.description: Aggregate with GROUP BY via JPQL — categories with product count and avg price

B3.description: Many-to-many via JOIN FETCH — products by tag with category in single query

C1.description: Bulk insert — 10,000 products in chunks of 500 via Hibernate session.doWork() JDBC batch

C2.description: Bulk update — native SQL UPDATE FROM subquery, LIMIT 1000 rows (see methodology/c2_limit_analysis.json)

D1.description: Unit of Work — EntityManager persist + flush: order with 5 items, 11 queries total
